headline_original: Bessent: The European Union has officially joined Operation Economic Outcast
headline_cs: Bessent: Evropská unie se připojila k operaci finanční izolace Íránu
summary_cs: Americký ministr financí Scott Bessent uvedl, že Evropská unie se připojila k Operation Economic Outcast zaměřené na odříznutí íránského režimu od globálního finančního systému a financování jaderného programu, zbraní a proxy skupin. Jde o další koordinované zpřísnění ekonomického tlaku na Írán; samo o sobě nejde o vojenský útok, ale zvyšuje riziko odvety a prodlužuje geopolitickou prémii kolem Hormuzu a ropy.

predictions.mechanism: Coordinated US-EU financial pressure on Iran raises the probability of retaliation or prolonged confrontation, supporting geopolitical safe-haven demand; the weak dollar and easing Treasury yields are also supportive.
predictions.invalidation: A rapid de-escalation in US-Iran relations, clear progress toward negotiations, or a sharp rebound in DXY and US real/nominal yields overwhelms the sanctions risk premium.

predictions.mechanism: Deeper EU involvement in financial pressure on Iran extends geopolitical and energy-price tail risk for Europe, which is relatively sensitive to imported energy costs.
predictions.invalidation: Oil prices fall materially and no Iranian retaliation or further sanctions escalation follows.

predictions.mechanism: EU participation in the sanctions campaign increases the chance of prolonged Middle East tension and an energy-cost risk premium for European equities.
predictions.invalidation: Brent falls decisively and the sanctions move is followed by de-escalatory diplomacy rather than retaliation.

predictions.mechanism: The headline modestly raises geopolitical and oil-inflation tail risk, but low VIX and easing Treasury yields limit the expected equity downside.
predictions.invalidation: No further escalation occurs and oil/yields continue easing while risk appetite remains firm.

predictions.mechanism: Safe-haven and weaker-dollar support are offset by silver's cyclical exposure if sanctions raise energy costs and hurt growth expectations.
predictions.invalidation: Dollar, yields and risk appetite align decisively enough to dominate silver's conflicting monetary and industrial-demand channels.
